description: This file defines a controller class for the OrangeHRM system, specifically handling the saving of social media authentication providers within the OpenID authentication plugin. It extends a base Vue controller and sets up a Vue component in its pre-render phase.

classes.name: SaveSocialMediaAuthProviderController
classes.description: Controller class for saving social media authentication providers in the OpenID plugin, extending AbstractVueController.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Pre-render hook that initializes a Vue component named 'add-auth-provider' before rendering.
